algorithms.name: Complete-profile equivalence/departure decisions and outer repeated-sampling calibration

configuration.description: Prospectively frozen repeated-sampling benchmark of complete-profile equivalence/departure/unresolved rules; separate development/evaluation streams, no tuning from evaluation.

eligibility.application: Any eligibility is restricted to the simulated observation model. Twelve observed seasonal months, unknown fluence tails, independence and absent physical resource bounds cannot be certified by a favorable simulated family. Solar's robust primary verdict remains unresolved unless its sampling assumptions are independently justified.
eligibility.rules: A family/block-count/method passes only if every frozen profile shape has false-equivalence and false-departure Wilson upper bounds <=0.065 and coverage Wilson lower bound >=0.925. Centered and known-bound methods use simultaneous full-vector coverage; the percentile extension uses Delta interval coverage and is not a simultaneous-vector method. Coverage/decision criteria are operational tolerances, not a theorem or universal certification. Missing reference methods are unavailable, not passing.

configuration.interpretation: Calibrates statistical operating characteristics for declared complete-profile targets and observation processes. Generating profiles and resource allocation are imposed; this is method validation, not evidence for autonomous allocation or a novel natural law.
configuration.resource: Generated additive per-block resource totals in arbitrary resource units; zero bins retained. Population estimand is normalized arithmetic mean raw resource per fixed log-bin width.
configuration.stream_recipe: SeedSequence([stage_data_seed, block_count_index, profile_index, observation_family_index]); independent bootstrap stream SeedSequence([bootstrap_seed, stage_index, block_count_index, profile_index, observation_family_index]). Corrected/misspecified detection share family index 3 for paired identical latent resources/inclusion draws, while all outer datasets within a scenario are independent. Stage indices: development 0, evaluation 1.

algorithms.name: Frozen measured-cost forecasts and gated complete-profile decisions on an unused solar year
Posthoc independent catalogue/accounting audit; no forecast refitting

configuration.application_gate: A formal profile verdict requires benchmark support for the matching small-block/heavy-tail/dependence regime and independently established applicability of the candidate's sampling assumptions. Calendar months are not declared independent/exchangeable by default. No resource bound is inferred from development or evaluation maxima. Failed or unestablished eligibility yields formal verdict unresolved regardless of conditional band or point estimate.
configuration.conditioning: Complete-case count shape conditional on the eligible evaluation event total; no absolute rate or total-fluence forecast
configuration.cost_estimation: Arithmetic mean measured development fluence separately in each supported pooled class; no assumed power-law cost and no fit to evaluation outcomes
configuration.directory_information_before_freeze: NOAA directory listing names v1-0-1 annual 2025 product, about 611 KB, modified 2026-06-25; event bytes have not been acquired or inspected by this analysis
configuration.eligibility: Finite positive peak irradiance, peak_saturated equal to zero, closed fixed coordinate domain, finite positive resource and positive corresponding event-window duration; preserve all exclusions and resource-specific missingness
limitations: 2022-2024 development observations and the earlier study have already been inspected
Public 2025 catalogue is already measured, and local acquisition ordering does not establish global blindness
No catalogue completeness, exposure, overlapping-event or background correction
Related peak and fluence measurements share instrument and event definitions
One validation year supplies only 12 potentially seasonal/dependent monthly blocks
High-resource events may dominate monthly totals; finite sample maxima do not establish a physical upper bound
Within-class composition and solar-cycle changes may prevent cost transfer
Count-score intervals are conditional nominal bootstrap summaries, not a neutrality null test
configuration.margin_rationale: Exploratory operational margin fixed before acquisition: every resource density must be within [2/3,1.5] of the domain mean, distinguishing approximate equality from sustained 50% excess or 33% deficit. It is not derived from instrument accuracy, established prior law, or evaluation outcomes.
configuration.missingness_gate: Primary rise fluence must be complete among eligible in-domain peak events for an all-catalogue resource interpretation; otherwise retain complete-case forecasts but classify all-catalogue neutrality unresolved. End fluence is always an explicitly missingness-limited sensitivity.
configuration.pooling: Use development events only. From highest fine bin downward, merge neighbors until both resources have at least 20 complete development events per class; merge any undersupported lowest remainder into its neighbor. Retain outer domain and actual log/linear widths.
configuration.profile_candidate: Centered-bootstrap simultaneous log-profile band from orthopolity.profile_calibration.profile_decision; method benchmark and application gate must be retained before evaluation acquisition
configuration.profile_definition: phi_j = (sum_j q / sum_all q) / (Delta log k_j / total Delta log k), retaining zero evaluation bins
configuration.resource_definition: Supplied GOES XRS-B start-to-peak or start-to-end integrated irradiance at the observer, J/m2, without additional background subtraction; not total radiated flare energy
configuration.score_uncertainty: Independently resample 12 complete calendar-month vectors within each development year and within evaluation year; preserve joint bins and pair draws across forecasts and resource definitions
configuration.status: Forecast and analysis frozen before this analysis acquires or inspects the public 2025 event bytes; not prospective data collection, external preregistration, or global blinding
configuration.tls_policy: HTTPS certificate and hostname verification remain enabled. Prefer system OpenSSL CA bundle /etc/ssl/cert.pem when present, otherwise platform default roots; record TLS trust metadata without changing machine settings.
configuration.zero_bin_policy: No evaluation-based pooling, dropping zero bins or smoothing. Unsupported bootstrap development costs invalidate that resource's score draw. Zero evaluation resource bins prevent a finite log band and produce an unresolved candidate result.
